title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Scheffler and McIlroy on LIV Return
items.text: Scottie Scheffler supports LIV players returning to the PGA Tour but with penalties, while Rory McIlroy questions the value stars like Jon Rahm and Bryson DeChambeau brought to LIV Golf.

items.headline: Player of the Year Debate Heats Up
items.text: With two PGA Tour playoff events left, Rory McIlroy bluntly weighed in on the Player of the Year award debate amid intensifying discussions.
